## Non-negotiables

- **Phone:** below the width where the desktop bar fits, ONE trigger ("Filters" + active count) opens ONE
  modal view; every filter is a section or a sub-view inside it; no popover, combobox or sideways pill
  row inside or around it. Other popups on the same phone screen become sheets.
- **Draft + Apply:** the modal edits a draft; Apply writes the URL/store once; close discards; Reset
  clears the draft; a result count only when it is cheap.
- **Imperative handle:** a typed `…Handle` (`open()` / `close()`), `ref.current?.open()` from the parent,
  the modal owns its open state and draft. Controlled `open` only when open-ness is app/URL state.
- **Accessible:** dialog semantics (native `<dialog>` or `role=dialog` + `aria-modal`), focus in /
  trapped / restored, Esc and the system back gesture close, body scroll locked, safe-area insets,
  ≥ 44px targets, `prefers-reduced-motion` honoured.
- **No horizontal page scroll at 360px.** The desktop layout stays exactly as it was.

## Done means

Checks pass; the phone pass (360×740, 390×844 touch) and a desktop before/after comparison were run and
the screenshot paths are listed; your reply names the files changed and anything you could not verify.
